'''Jarobi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He resided in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
